title: Power Stack 10Y Rate-Resilience Overlay
purpose: Research-priority and action-gate overlay for the 5%+ U.S. 10-year regime. Does not mechanically overwrite company fundamental scores.

macroGate.coreRead: The 10Y is the gating variable. Breadth, valuation and financing are already taking damage while concentrated AI/semiconductor earnings keep the cap-weighted index resilient.
macroGate.admissionQuestion: Can this company beat a 5.2% risk-free hurdle without multiple expansion?

regimes.name: RELIEF
regimes.decision: Broaden the queue toward GNRC and premium grid/power names, subject to valuation and earnings confirmation.

regimes.name: NARROW RESILIENCE
regimes.decision: Concentrate research/new-capital priority in the strongest cash generators; stage entries; reject mediocre thematic exposure.

regimes.name: DISORDERLY REPRICING
regimes.decision: Raise the admission hurdle again; financing-heavy, premium-multiple and distant-cash-flow names move toward WAIT/WATCH.

regimes.name: GROWTH / CREDIT SCARE
regimes.decision: Do not interpret lower yields mechanically as bullish; prefer balance-sheet resilience and current cash generation.

implementation.researchOrder: ITRI > BDC > KLIC > AZZ > GNRC > AMKR
implementation.scorePolicy: This overlay changes research priority and entry/action gates. Fundamental conviction scores require company-specific evidence and are not mechanically changed by the macro overlay.
implementation.executionRule: Do not average down merely because a Power Stack name has corrected. Add only when the operating thesis remains intact and the rate-resilience test is passed.
